title: 第9章 如何苟延残喘第10章 九转登天步
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
这个老乡，正是李凡易容的。
这次戏弄对手，比较成功。
李凡不是没想过，制造一个机会，让对手大意，然后偷袭，用上品法器铃铛攻击，也有很大可能，灭杀大寨主。
可是，经过一番沉思，李凡否定这个想法。
炼气后期修士，天知道他有什么杀手锏，自己和对方的实力，差距太大，万一偷袭不成，自己只有被灭杀的份儿。
一向谨慎的李凡，可不愿再次冒险。
奔逃！
只有远走高飞，才是上上策！
……
两个月后，江安城的城门，出现一个风尘仆仆的年轻人，正是狂奔两个月，彻底摆脱大寨主追杀的李凡。
“长期居住，还是短暂停留？”
城门的卫兵面无表情的问。
“短暂停留！”
李凡回答的干脆，他需要进城查看一下，适不适合自己长期定居。
“两块灵石，十天！”
卫士还是惜字如金。
李凡有点肉疼，虽然现在他不再为灵石发愁，可是骨子里还是有小农意识。
办理完手续，领一个身份手环，李凡终于进城。
李凡没有进任何店铺，客栈，而是悠闲的转悠一圈，了解一些这座城市的基本情况。
首先，这座城市的规模，比源城大许多，但也不是真正的修仙城市，属于仙凡混居。

其次，这里炼气后期的修士，也十分稀少，当然，这里已经有官方组织，城主据说是一个筑基期修士。
只是，这位城主并不管日常事务，只是起到一个震慑作用。
了解这里的基本情况，李凡没有着急。
而是找一家生意不算太好的客栈，先住下。
这两个月，疲于奔命，李凡先是大吃大喝一顿，然后呼呼大睡两天。
满血复活！
李凡开始思量今后的修炼之路。
灵石，他已经根本不缺，现在，他唯一的缺点，是遁术！
这次大寨主的追杀，如果已经有一门顶级的遁术功法，何至于逃跑的如此狼狈。
休整两天，李凡出门，开始在几家修仙店铺转悠。
可是，这次不再顺利，没有遇到自己满意的遁术功法。
而且，这些店铺出售的遁术功法，都是基于炼气五层才能修炼。
可是，一向沉稳的李凡，也没有失落。
机缘这东西，可遇不可求。
这天，李凡在一家规模不大的店铺，随意收购几件废弃的法器，聊胜于无嘛。
“嗯，道友，听说今年的年会，会搬到夫子庙那里举行。”
“不错，那里是古建筑，显得档次高一点，地方也宽敞。”
content_en:
This fellow is exactly what Li Fan disguised himself as.
This time, teasing the opponent was more successful.
It wasn't like Li Fan hadn't thought about it. Creating an opportunity to make his opponent careless, and then making a sneak attack and attacking with a high-grade magical weapon, the bell, would be very likely to kill the leader of the village.
However, after some reflection, Li Fan rejected this idea.
A monk in the late stage of Qi refining, God knows what trump card he has. There is a huge gap in strength between himself and his opponent. If the sneak attack fails, he will only be killed.
Li Fan, who has always been cautious, is unwilling to take risks again.
flee!
The only best option is to fly far away!
…
Two months later, at the gate of Jiang'an City, a dusty young man appeared. It was Li Fan who had been running wildly for two months and completely escaped the pursuit of the leader of the village.
"Long-term stay or short-term stay?"
The guard at the city gate asked expressionlessly.
"Short stay!"
Li Fan answered simply that he needed to go to the city to check whether it was suitable for him to settle down for a long time.
"Two spiritual stones, ten days!"
The guards still cherish words like gold.
Li Fan felt a little sick. Although he no longer worried about the spirit stone, he still had the consciousness of a small farmer in his heart.
After completing the formalities and receiving an identity bracelet, Li Fan finally entered the city.
Li Fan did not enter any shops or inns, but walked around leisurely to learn about some basic conditions of the city.
First of all, the size of this city is much larger than that of Source City, but it is not a true immortal city. It is a mixed city of immortals and mortals.
Secondly, there are very few monks in the late stage of Qi refining here. Of course, there is already an official organization here, and the city owner is said to be a monk in the foundation building stage.
However, this city lord does not care about daily affairs and only acts as a deterrent.
After understanding the basic situation here, Li Fan was not in a hurry.
Instead, find an inn that is not very busy and stay there first.
In the past two months, exhausted from running around, Li Fan first ate and drank a lot, and then slept hard for two days.
Resurrection with full blood!
Li Fan began to think about his future path of cultivation.
He has no shortage of spiritual stones. Now, his only shortcoming is his escape technique!
In this pursuit of the leader of the village, if he already had a top-notch escape technique, why would he be able to escape in such an embarrassing manner?
After two days of rest, Li Fan went out and started wandering around several immortal shops.
However, this time it was no longer smooth, and I did not encounter the escape technique that I was satisfied with.
Moreover, the escape techniques sold in these stores are all based on the fifth level of Qi refining.
However, Li Fan, who had always been calm, was not disappointed.
Opportunity is something that can only come by chance.
On this day, Li Fan randomly purchased a few discarded magical artifacts from a small shop, which was better than nothing.
"Well, fellow Taoist, I heard that this year's annual meeting will be held at Confucius Temple."
"Yes, it's an ancient building. It looks a bit higher-grade and the place is spacious."
